h1: Custom Scrub Beanies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom scrub beanies in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for healthcare branding. Soft, comfortable, and embroiderable.
introHtml: Scrub beanies are a practical choice for healthcare teams, clinics, and medical facilities looking for comfortable headwear that stays in place during long shifts. Made from soft acrylic or cotton blends, these beanies can be embroidered with your logo or department name for a cohesive uniform look. Unlike standard beanies, scrub beanies are designed to fit under surgical caps or be worn alone, offering both warmth and functionality in sterile environments.
heroAltText: Custom scrub beanies with embroidered logo, soft knit fabric, available in bulk for healthcare teams
